candidate_windows.window_text: We use MetaVoice-1B (MetaVoice) as the base voice cloning model, while our framework can be easily extended to any embedding-conditioned voice cloning model. We conduct speech generation on a single NVIDIA L40 GPU. We use an additional NVIDIA L40 GPU for text retrieval in text-retrieval based open-ended emotion control. We provide an audio sample page at emoknob.cs.columbia.edu.
